result.evidence:
I checked branch v2/t-bank-lines_angles_and_triangles (20ea57d) against v2/t-bank (9403838) in fresh detached worktrees, which I have since removed. The diff is the 3 lines in triangles.py, the finish() SPR branch plus the import. Scripts and dumps are in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-workingmyassof-satbank/9030c288-6222-49fa-a25a-6e6802e22cd3/scratchpad/verify_lat/.

1+2. I dumped all 31 templates, seeds 0-80, three times each: default, fmt=mcq and fmt=spr. That is 7,533 lines per branch. Every dataclass field except spr_mistakes was compared: stem, choices, reasons, latex_choices, answer, key, rationale, params, figure, table and fmt. `diff base_main.txt after_main.txt` is empty, and exceptions and retries land at the same seeds on both branches. So multiple-choice output is identical, and grid-ins differ only in spr_mistakes.

Invariants: I scanned every grid-in produced (seeds 0-80, all three modes). 0 violations: no entry is None, equals the key, is irrational or repeats another. No multiple-choice item carries spr_mistakes. All 23 covered templates carry a non-empty list on 100% of their grid-ins. lat.area_range carries none.

3. I recomputed 15 random grid-ins by hand, one per template, plus 8 more. 21 matched their reason exactly. Two did not: lat.altitude_legs seed 4 and lat.parallel_segments seed 10 (see the defects). Both come from wording in the templates' existing mistake lists, which multiple-choice already prints today. This branch did not introduce them.

4. `PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m satbank check --topic lines_angles_and_triangles` prints "Lines, Angles, and Triangles [lines_angles_and_triangles] PASS" (9,227 items re-derived). server/test_flow.py prints "all good".

5. tools/spr_coverage.py shows 23 of 24. The only template left is lat.area_range, which calls finish(..., [], ...) and has no mistake logic. transversal_proof, transversal_inequality, eight_angles, isosceles_possible, ratio_match, similar_needed, similar_sufficient and the similar_angle "expr" mode never produce a grid-in. No template is missing coverage.

Why pass is true: every rule of the task holds. The two defects were already in the templates, and fixing them would change multiple-choice reason text, which rule 1 of this task forbids. They still mislabel about half of those two templates' grid-in mistakes, so they need a separate, deliberate change.

defects.what: Existing bug in the template, now passed on to grid-ins. TRIPLES includes (4k,3k,5k) and (24k,7k,25k), so p is often the longer leg. When it is (44 of 81 grid-ins, seeds 0-80), four reasons name the wrong leg. Example, seed 4 fmt=spr (p=80, q=60, h=100, key 48): 64 is labelled 'squared the shorter leg' but is 80²/100; 36 is labelled 'squared the longer leg' but is 60²/100; 30 is labelled 'halved the longer leg', but half of 80 is 40; 20 is labelled 'subtracted the shorter leg from the hypotenuse', but 100−60 is 40. A student who halves the longer leg types 40, which matches nothing, and 30 is filed under the wrong mistake. The multiple-choice reasons carry the same mislabels today.
defects.fix: Separate change, not in this branch: compute short, long = sorted((p, q)) and build those four entries from short and long. That changes multiple-choice reasons, and some values, on p>q draws, so it needs the user's approval as a deliberate multiple-choice change. The figure and key stay as they are.

defects.what: Existing bug in the template, now passed on to grid-ins. The reason says 'dividing by the shorter piece instead of the longer one', but the value BC·AB/FE divides by FE where the correct answer divides by AB. The wording is only true when FE < AB. In 41 of 81 grid-ins (seeds 0-80), FE > AB and the phrase is backwards. Example, seed 10 fmt=spr: AB=17.75, FE=28.25, and 26.7 is labelled as dividing by the shorter piece. The value itself is computed as the code intends.
defects.fix: Separate change: reword the reason to fit every draw, e.g. 'matched the sides the wrong way round, dividing by FE instead of AB' with the labels filled in. This changes multiple-choice reason text, so it needs the user's approval.
